verdict.line: You lose if you facecheck melee range while Urgot's E (Disdain) is up; you win if you bait that flip into your W (Riposte) and punish the empty cooldown.

brief.thesis: Urgot has exactly one all-in tool, E (Disdain), and Fiora has exactly one tool that hard-answers it, W (Riposte). The entire lane is decided by whether Urgot lands that flip or burns it into a parry — everything else is a flat stat-check that the measured 46.9% win rate over 1208 games says is roughly even.

theirWindow.when: He lands Q poke, E still up
theirWindow.what: Once Corrosive Charge (800 range) has chipped you and Disdain is off cooldown, he can charge in, fling you off a wave or away from your support, and follow with point-blank Purge for a real burst. Respect his 800-range Q before you have W reliably up, and don't stand still in minion wave after he's hit you with it.

yourWindow.what: With no engage or disengage tool up (16/15.5/15/14.5/14s CD), Urgot is just a ranged auto-attacker with no mobility. Double-lunge in with Q, pop E (Burst of Speed) for the attack speed and stacking move speed, and stay on him — he cannot create distance until Disdain resets.

start.why: Picked in 83.9% of games (48.1% WR over 1186) — the lifesteal and AD feed directly into Duelist sustain for the extended trades this matchup forces.

boots.why: 83.7% pick, 47.7% WR over 1075 games — Urgot's entire kit is physical damage (autos, Echoing Flames, Q, Purge), so flat damage reduction outvalues Mercury's Treads here.

core.why: Most-picked first core item (32.6% of games on this path) — the lifesteal and cleave sustain you through poke while you wait out his E cooldown.
Spellblade procs amplify your Lunge-into-auto trade pattern, and the move speed stacks with your E for sticking to a Flash-less Urgot.
Damage-over-time conversion blunts his Echoing Flames and Purge chip so you don't get ground down in extended fights.

situational.when: you're ahead and looking to one-shot him through his execute threshold before he can Purge
lane is attrition-heavy and you need the extra sustain over raw burst
fights are dragging and you need ability haste to loop Q/W/E faster than his cooldowns

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-performing page here (53.7% WR, 8.4% pick) — the stacking adaptive damage and heal conversion match Fiora's passive sustain in a lane that's decided by who wins the extended stat-check, not a single burst window.

summoners.why: 86.3% pick rate (47.1% WR) — Flash lets you dodge or follow up a baited Disdain, and Ignite closes out the exact kind of low-HP window his own execute R is trying to deny you.

playing.title: Hold W for Disdain
playing.detail: Riposte's parry (750 range, 10/9/8/7/6s CD) directly negates his only engage. Bait the E in, parry it, and he's left standing with zero mobility to escape the counter-attack.

playing.title: Respect his Q range pre-6
playing.detail: Corrosive Charge reaches 800 range and slows on explosion — let minions soak it and only commit your Q (600 range) once he's already used Q or E.

playing.title: Double-lunge on cooldown windows
playing.detail: Q can be re-cast within a couple seconds at no mana cost. Use the second dash the instant his E goes down, since it's his only gap-closer and disengage.

playing.title: Pop E once you're already in
playing.detail: Burst of Speed's attack speed and the move speed from each landed hit matter after you've parried or dodged his flip — it's a sticking tool, not an engage tool.

playing.title: Save R for isolated picks
playing.detail: Blade Waltz (400 range, 130/120/110s CD) deals reduced damage on repeat hits to the same target, so it's better spent diving a second target than farming damage onto Urgot alone.

playing.title: Track his ult range after trading
playing.detail: Fear Beyond Death reaches 2500 range and executes below a health threshold — don't walk away from a won trade at low HP, even off-screen.

brief.patchCaveat: Build path, runes, summoners and all win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning — why the E/W interaction and cooldown windows matter — is my own read of the kit, not OP.GG data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Urgot’s (E) or block it with [W]. Keep your distance while contesting with [Q] to gain the upper hand.
